title: A finite algebra over a local ring with a single prime has finitely many primes, all maximal and over the maximal ideal
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a local ring whose only prime ideal is $\mathfrak m$, and let $B$ be a finite $R$-algebra (a ring map $R\to B$ making $B$ a finitely generated $R$-module). Then $B$ has only finitely many prime ideals $\mathfrak q_1,\dots,\mathfrak q_r$ ($r\ge0$); each of them is a maximal ideal of $B$ and lies over $\mathfrak m$ (its preimage in $R$ is $\mathfrak m$); and their intersection $\mathfrak q_1\cap\dots\cap\mathfrak q_r$ is the nilradical of $B$ (every element of it is nilpotent). Equivalently, $\operatorname{Spec}B$ is a finite discrete space.
